story_info.title: Penny Penguin's Tidy Home Fun
story_info.subtitle: A story about helping at home.
story_info.moral: Helping to tidy your home makes your body move and your mind feel happy and quiet.

main_character.name: Penny Penguin
main_character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.

slides.title: Saturday Morning
slides.text: Saturday morning was bright. Penny Penguin woke up with a big smile. She stretched her little wings and feet. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" she said loudly. Penny looked around her cozy igloo. Her favourite fluffy cloud toy was on the floor. Her shiny shells were scattered near her bed.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Penny and her home on a bright Saturday morning. Show her energetic start.

slides.title: A Little Mess
slides.text: "Oh dear," Penny said, looking around. Her home was a bit messy. It was hard to find her things. A clean home helps a happy mind. Penny loved to play fun games. But she also loved a clean, quiet place. She wanted to feel ready for Saturday adventures.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny notices the mess and understands why a tidy space is good for her mind. Set up the small challenge.

slides.title: Tidying Game
slides.text: Penny had a good idea! She put on her favourite happy music. It had a bouncy beat. Penny started a sorting game. "Let's put all the blue things here!" she sang. She moved quickly around her room. She put her small blue scarf into a blue box.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny finds a creative solution to the mess by making tidying a fun game with music.

slides.title: Helping Herself
slides.text: Next, Penny picked up her storybooks. She stacked them neatly on her little shelf. Then she wiped her tiny table clean. Her small, strong flippers worked fast. Tidying made her body move. It felt like a fun little dance as she worked!
slides.speaker_notes: Detail Penny's actions as she tidies, showing the physical aspect of helping at home.

slides.title: Happy and Ready
slides.text: Soon, Penny's home was clean and neat. Everything had its own special place. She felt so happy and good. Penny smiled a big, proud smile. Her healthy body worked hard. Now her mind felt quiet. She was ready for a lovely, fun Saturday!
slides.speaker_notes: The story ends with Penny enjoying the results of her hard work, feeling happy and calm, ready for the rest of her day.
